title: nan
authors: Jarraya I.; Abdelkader M.; Gabr K.; Almusalami A.; Kadri M.B.; Koubaa A.
key_contribution: Presents a comparative study of non-visual terrain-aided navigation methods (TERCOM vs SITAN with EKF/UKF/RLS) integrated with KD-Tree search space reduction for UAVs in GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
